# Lines & Arrows

> Open source sequence diagrams stored as readable text, with a browser renderer, visual editor, and DOM-free validation API.

Use the agent guide to author, validate, and render Lines & Arrows.

## Documentation

- [Agent guide](https://lines-and-arrows.dev/agents): Author, validate, and render Lines & Arrows in web pages, constrained browser hosts, and Node.js.

## Tools and examples

- [Constructor](https://lines-and-arrows.dev/constructor): Build and configure a diagram visually, then copy its HTML.
- [Showcase](https://lines-and-arrows.dev/showcase): Rendered and editable examples.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/apurin/lines-and-arrows): Source, package documentation, and issue tracker.
